fit: complete original index and separate plant-development reference
assessment: The genuine strawberry fruit entry indexes small auxin-up RNAs. The indexed source is a plant gene-expression chapter, with page 133 still outside the available body. No assignment or falls estimate.

fit: freeze-dried strawberry and provoked time-to-fall tasks in aging rats
assessment: Strawberry stayed on the plank longer than blueberry and the stationary rod for less time than blueberry. Strawberry and unsupplemented feed did not differ clearly on rod, rotarod or plank. The study gives no clinical fall rate.

fit: strawberry extract, spatial retention and tissue dopamine after irradiation
assessment: The original abstract reports preservation of place information and measured dopamine release. The related behavior is spatial learning. Independence from other same-dose irradiation cohorts remains open.

fit: Parkinson gait and disability context without food assignment
assessment: The clinical report classifies severe abnormal gait in 84 of 214 assessed participants. It provides no frequency of recurring falls or fruit exposure.

fit: purified strawberry-associated constituent with repeated rotarod event counts
assessment: High-dose purified procyanidin B2 reduced the number of falls back onto a rotating-apparatus trial within five minutes. The reagent was not shown to come from strawberry, and the study used an experimental demyelination model. Fig. 2D and its prose disagree about the comparator latency.

fit: fall adverse events under single-arm strawberry-flavored cannabidiol
assessment: Two of 21 people had a Fall adverse event in the Rett safety report. Its window starts at the preceding randomized trial baseline. Strawberry flavoring is an excipient and there is no separate fruit comparator or recurrence measure.
